observation.command:
cd /tmp && nohup bash -c 'cmake -S gdal-src -B gdal-build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DGDAL_USE_CURL=ON -DGDAL_USE_GEOS=ON -DGDAL_USE_PROJ=ON -DGDAL_USE_TIFF=ON -DGDAL_USE_ZLIB=ON -DPNG_WANT_SIMPLE=ON > /tmp/gdal_cmake.log 2>&1 && cmake --build gdal-build -j8 >> /tmp/gdal_cmake.log 2>&1 && cmake --install gdal-build >> /tmp/gdal_cmake.log 2>&1 && ldconfig >> /tmp/gdal_cmake.log 2>&1 && echo GDAL_BUILD_OK > /tmp/gdal_build_done.txt' > /tmp/gdal_nohup.log 2>&1 &
echo "started $!"
